originating_goal: Fix the coding defect that prevents the machine-owned HB29 to HB30 transition from starting because WorkerCoordinator requires the separated carrier state before its execution loop can run.
claim_expiration_or_release_condition: Release after exact-head tests prove automatic initial carrier bootstrap, PR merges, canonical runtime handoff is reconciled, and no chat-owned implementation role remains.
collision_boundaries: Do not modify control/heartbeat-state.json or fabricate HB30 in repository source.
Do not acquire, release, renew, or alter the existing G18 claim/fence.
Do not create another heartbeat, WorkerCoordinator, scheduler, hosted runtime, or physical-machine prerequisite.
Do not introduce GitHub token, Render, hosted provider, or NON-TV/TVC secret/token authority.
Do not alter TV/TVC route authority, provider authority, wallet signing/broadcast authority, or Master Records custody authority.
Do not broaden the bootstrap exception beyond materializing the first separated-v12 carrier state from immutable HB29 before normal WorkerCoordinator startup.

implemented_resolution.defect: scripts/run_worker_runtime.py constructed WorkerCoordinator before an HB30 carrier existed; WorkerCoordinator._carrier_reference() fails closed when the carrier file is absent, while the transition producer that creates HB30 was only reachable through later worker execution paths.
implemented_resolution.repair: run_worker_runtime now invokes the existing canonical scripts/advance_heartbeat_transition.py exactly once when no separated carrier state exists and immutable legacy HB29 is present, then constructs WorkerCoordinator only after HB30+ is persisted.

expected_evidence: initial worker runtime startup materializes HB30+ before WorkerCoordinator construction
existing HB30+ is reused without another bootstrap transition
missing or non-HB29 legacy state fails closed
credential-bearing environment variables are not forwarded to the transition producer
full heartbeat worker validation remains green
next_executable_action: Run exact-head deterministic validation, inspect workflow jobs/logs, reconcile canonical handoff if green, merge while current, then observe whether normal machine execution can materialize HB30 without the former circular dependency.
